input: Content target of the active project; a Ton or Off segment from the chosen clip, the player-confirmed source IN/OUT and the confirmed source timebase.
output: story_parts, story_markers and story_state writes through the serialized content write transport; reads of segments (deleted ones for the Segment tab), all markers with the locked start and end, stored M-M slots (marker pair, has_cover) and the stored selection. The program model is the active segments on one axis, markers, slots, story timebase, total length, duration labels, v5 navigation (segment, slot, marker, first empty slot); navigation only asks for a program frame (take_seek) and draws the Wrap playhead given by qnc-wrap-session. It never chooses a source clip for the player. Covers (v5 quick_cover / overwrite_cover): B / Cover slot writes CreateCover for the selected empty slot, Overwrite for the selected slot or the selected cover's slot, from the source the caller marks (clip, confirmed IN/OUT, player timebase); the store makes it a B-roll virtual shot. Covers are drawn over their slot; a cover click selects it, a segment choice clears it, Delete takes marker, then cover, then segment. take_program_changed tells the Wrap view that segments or covers changed. Sync/B-roll (qnc-sync-cover): ToggleSync; IN on the source arms it; sync_space starts it in the Source view and gives the program window for the player; sync_frame maps window frames to program frames; O (finish_sync) or the end of the source closes the slot, writes its missing end marker, selects the stored slot; Enter (activate_focused_item) writes CreateCover; reaching the next marker or the source OUT only stops; sync_holds_enter keeps Enter from saving a short meanwhile. Marker editing (user rule 2026-09-25): Ctrl+M (select_marker) takes the selected marker, else the unlocked one nearest to the Wrap playhead, into a draft; arrows move the draft by one frame, M puts it on the Wrap playhead, a drag (DragMarker) sets it, the Wrap playhead shows it; Enter writes MoveMarker, Escape drops it; a draft stays strictly between its neighbours. Ctrl+M then Delete deletes it. One Delete press deletes one thing: only delete_marker (it holds every delete key in every preset) maps to DeleteSelected.
